newsitem.title: POLAND: BPH bond issue to go as public offering.
newsitem.headline: BPH bond issue to go as public offering.

text.p: The planned $100 million convertible bond issue by Poland's Bank Przemyslowo-Handlowy SA (BPH) will be in the form of a public offering, the bank said in a statement on Friday.
Earlier this week the bank's president said the decision on whether the issue would be a public offering or private placement would be taken by the second half of February.
She said the bonds were likely to be issued in the first half of April.
The bank will issue up to 100,000 fixed bonds with a par value of $1,000 each and a maturity of up to five years, with the issue exchangeable for up to 1,994,000 shares.
The funds from the issue are planned to finance the bank's credit expansion, especially the growth of foreign currency credits.
